key_idea: Look at which way each beak points, then count the birds on that side.
steps: From left to right, the beaks point: right, left, right, left.
The pink bird looks right and sees 3. The blue bird looks left and sees 1.
The green bird looks right and sees 1. The yellow bird looks left and sees 3.

choice_feedback.E: Check which way each beak points. The blue and green birds see only 1 bird each.
